arca_functions.function: private.arca_selfservice_hold_view(text,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,boolean,timestamp with time zone)

arca_constraints.name: arca_emission_attempts_cbtes_asoc_all_or_none
arca_constraints.definition: CHECK ((num_nonnulls(cbte_asoc_original_id, cbte_asoc_tipo, cbte_asoc_punto_venta, cbte_asoc_numero) = ANY (ARRAY[0, 4]))) NOT VALID

arca_constraints.name: arca_emission_attempts_cbtes_asoc_original_fk
arca_constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (cbte_asoc_original_id) REFERENCES comprobantes(id) NOT VALID

arca_constraints.name: arca_emission_attempts_cbtes_asoc_positive
arca_constraints.definition: CHECK ((((cbte_asoc_tipo IS NULL) OR (cbte_asoc_tipo > 0)) AND ((cbte_asoc_punto_venta IS NULL) OR (cbte_asoc_punto_venta > 0)) AND ((cbte_asoc_numero IS NULL) OR (cbte_asoc_numero > 0)))) NOT VALID

arca_constraints.name: arca_emission_attempts_comprobante_id_fkey
arca_constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (comprobante_id) REFERENCES comprobantes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

arca_constraints.name: arca_parametros_business_id_fkey
arca_constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (business_id) REFERENCES businesses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

arca_constraints.name: arca_credential_provision_requests_business_id_fkey
arca_constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (business_id) REFERENCES businesses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

arca_constraints.name: arca_credential_rotations_business_id_fkey
arca_constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (business_id) REFERENCES businesses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

arca_constraints.name: arca_credential_rotations_initial_verified_ticket_check
arca_constraints.definition: CHECK (((state <> 'pending_rotation'::text) OR (setup_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'initial'::text) OR ((wsaa_verified_at IS NULL) AND (verified_wsaa_token IS NULL) AND (verified_wsaa_sign IS NULL) AND (verified_wsaa_token_expires IS NULL)) OR ((wsaa_verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(COALESCE(verified_wsaa_token, ''::text)) <> ''::text) AND (btrim(COALESCE(verified_wsaa_sign, ''::text)) <> ''::text) AND (verified_wsaa_token_expires IS NOT NULL) AND (verified_wsaa_token_expires > wsaa_verified_at) AND (verification_hold IS NULL))))

arca_constraints.name: arca_credential_rotations_verification_hold_check
arca_constraints.definition: CHECK ((((verification_hold IS NULL) OR (verification_hold = ANY (ARRAY['in_flight'::text, 'result_unknown'::text, 'ticket_active'::text, 'verification_expired'::text, 'cooldown'::text]))) AND ((verification_hold IS NULL) = (verification_retry_not_before IS NULL))))

arca_constraints.name: arca_private_key_credentials_business_id_fkey
arca_constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (business_id) REFERENCES businesses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

arca_constraints.name: arca_private_key_credentials_created_by_fkey
arca_constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

arca_constraints.name: arca_private_key_credentials_updated_by_fkey
arca_constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
